pullRequest.title: Round cart totals to cents
pullRequest.body:
## Why

Cart totals were off by a cent when **tax** was applied per line. See [the issue](https://github.com/acme/shop/issues/11).

## What changed

- Round once, at the end
- Keep `Decimal` all the way through
  - including discounts
1. first
2. second

```python
total = sum(lines).quantize(CENT)
```

> Tested with the receipts from #11.
